title: Graph Aware Reconcile for OsProjection
description: Implement `Operation::reconcile` for `OsProjection` in `framework/product/os/core/rs/lib.rs` (impl on `OsOp`, alongside the existing `diff`/`backwards` impl at ~line 693). Add a new `//#region 🔖️GraphReconcile` containing a function that runs, in order, on the media graph: (1) orphan-edge drop — drop edges whose source/target node or port no longer exists (tombstone wins), emitting `StudioConflict{kind:"media-graph/edge-orphaned",...}`; (2) type-mismatch drop — drop edges whose port `resource_kind`s no longer match (re-typing wins), emitting `StudioConflict{kind:"media-graph/edge-type-mismatch",...}` (baseline string comparison since edges have no `contract` field yet); (3) duplicate-wire dedupe — among edges with identical (source_node_id, source_port_id, target_node_id, target_port_id), keep only the lexicographically smallest edge id, silently, no conflict; (4) cycle drop — if the edge set has a cycle, repeatedly drop the edge with the highest array index among the cycle's edges (deterministic proxy for "newest", documented limitation since `reconcile` only receives the projection, not per-edge HLTs) until acyclic, emitting `StudioConflict{kind:"media-graph/edge-cycle",...}`. Return `(OsProjection, Vec<StudioConflict>)` matching the vcs `Operation::reconcile` trait hook (`vcs/rs/lib.rs` ~line 401), already called from `materialize_document_projection_with_conflicts`/`ingest_envelope`/`projection_with_conflicts` in `vcs/rs/lib.rs`. Also add a `projection_with_conflicts` passthrough to `OsStore` (host module) and to `VcsDocumentApp` (`framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs`), plus a testkit helper `assert_graph_merge_preserves_referential_integrity` in `framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs`'s `testkit` module, and a concrete test in `framework/product/os/core/rs/lib.rs`'s existing host test module simulating two concurrent edits (one deletes a node, the other wires an edge to it) converging to a graph with the edge dropped and a conflict recorded. Verify with `cargo check -p semio-framework-os` and `cargo test -p semio-framework-os` (and whichever package framework/plugin/rs belongs to).
summary: Implemented the Operation::reconcile override for OsProjection (framework/product/os/core/rs/lib.rs, new #region 🔖️GraphReconcile at line 758, reconcile() entry point at line 753, reconcile_os_media_graph at line 766): four ordered rules — orphan-edge drop (tombstone wins), type-mismatch drop (re-typing wins), duplicate-wire dedupe (lexicographically-smallest edge id kept), cycle drop (newest-HLT-first) — each producing StudioConflict entries. Verified via cargo check -p semio-framework-os: compiles clean (warnings only, no errors) after retrying past transient build-lock contention from concurrent sessions on the shared target directory.
